_comment: Sidecar for tools/law-sources.mjs, keyed by the EXACT cite string as it
appears on a data/hud.json line (e.g. "Fla. Stat. §318.14(3)"). Each entry
is one statute source that has been individually verified: fetched, read,
confirmed CURRENT (never a year-pinned snapshot), and confirmed to contain
This file is DIFFERENT from research/law-watch.json's own 4 hand-verified
sources, which watch the original 3-state pack.html citations (a separate,
older citation surface) and are never touched by tools/law-sources.mjs.
As of 2026-09-04 this file is seeded with ZERO entries. data/hud.json cites
230 distinct sections across 51 states; none has a verified source URL on
record (research/state-matrix.md carries citations, never URLs — confirmed
by grep). Populating this file is the same kind of per-section research
pass that built the matrix itself (research/archive/state-law-matrix-ledger.md
documents the method: codes.findlaw.com defeats most IP bans, but its URL
slug must be verified per state — two states 404'd on the pattern that
worked everywhere else). It is not a same-day task; run
Add an entry only after actually fetching the URL and confirming the anchor
text is present in the response — never from a URL pattern alone.
